notes: Scope: 3 files under web/ only (package.json scripts, new scripts/run-tool.mjs, new scripts/run-tool.test.mjs). No auth/oidc/session/migration files, no CI workflow files, no dependency changes. Fully revertible.

Premise confirmed in the worktree: old-style `tsc -b --pretty false --silent` exits 1 with TS5072 and `vite build --silent` exits 1 (CACError); after the change `corepack pnpm typecheck --silent` and `corepack pnpm build --silent` both exit 0 and produce dist/.

Error passthrough verified end-to-end: with a deliberate TS2322 error in src/, `pnpm typecheck --silent` still exits 2 and prints the diagnostic, so the wrapper does not mask failures (it drops the flag instead of translating to a vite/tsc quiet mode, as the comment says).

Tests exercise the real script via spawnSync (not stubs): 4/4 node:test pass; they would fail on the pre-change tree because the script did not exist and the behaviour they assert (tsc --version --silent exit 0) is rejected by tsc directly.

All CI gates that ci.yml runs were executed locally and pass: openapi:check, lint (eslint, 0 warnings), format:check (prettier), typecheck, test (vitest 83 files/908 tests + node --test 8 pass), build. Dockerfile copies web/ wholesale after pnpm install, so scripts/run-tool.mjs is present in the image build stage.
Minor, non-blocking: stripping also removes a trailing -s/-q, which no current script passes deliberately; only trailing flags are removed so mid-line flags are preserved (covered by a test).
